actual: Production Batch B request 9a10e69c over 1632 dates produced 13058 source requirements. BUILD_SOURCE_CATALOG creates a new 24-process spawn pool for every 32-item chunk, repeatedly imports the full application, rereads highly overlapping market and fundamental windows from PostgreSQL, and repeats all reads in VERIFY. Observed 25 processes, 6.39 GB working set, 23.66 GB private commit, and about 30 requirements per minute; model training had not started. User requires range-batched database extraction, repo-external file cache plus bounded in-memory indexes, persistent bounded workers, no per-requirement database fetch, under-8GB memory, unchanged PIT and evidence semantics, visible errors, and no new approval gates.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
